g.text: Nerve workspace packages: purposes and allowed dependencies
HTTP/WebSocket daemon, persistence, host use cases,
process drivers, runtime, and static web host
UI kit intentionally has no @nervekit dependency.
Port-driven run semantics and concrete process drivers
Presentation cannot import app shells, feature state,
runtime network communication, not an import dependency
The compile-time graph and internal purity rules are enforced by scripts/check-package-boundaries.mjs.
